1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a Product Designer at Parashift Technologies and noticed your focus on building intuitive web applications and complex dashboards.

During my time as a UI/UX designer at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated user findings directly into improved user flows, prototypes, and wireframes. I also built brand guidelines and visual identity systems that helped early-stage startups establish clear design standards.

My B2B case study, Bounceless, demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I would love to share a quick look at how I structure product flows and handle developer handoffs. I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai for this role.

Ananya

Ananya Saini

2.body:
Hello,

Your Graphic Designer opening at Apricot caught my attention, particularly your mission connecting small-scale farmers directly with global consumers through heritage-led and transparent brand storytelling.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I produce digital and print marketing collateral across multiple formats, having delivered over 100 assets including banners, presentations, and marketing materials. I also built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time for stakeholders.

My social campaign for a fashion brand demonstrates my ability to execute engaging multi-format visual assets that achieved a fifteen percent increase in follower engagement, which you can review in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick look at a few of my recent projects?

Ananya
